pii_policy: No raw customer content, secrets, health/legal/payment data or identity fields are event payloads.

executive_events.name: asset_view
executive_events.meaning: A canonical page or asset was viewed.
executive_events.decision_use: Denominator for owned-site reach; not a success metric alone.

executive_events.name: tool_start
executive_events.meaning: A visitor made the first meaningful interaction with a diagnostic tool.
executive_events.decision_use: Measures whether the promise produces action.

executive_events.name: tool_complete
executive_events.meaning: A diagnostic tool produced its result after required inputs.
executive_events.decision_use: Measures value delivery before form friction.

executive_events.name: lead_form_submit
executive_events.meaning: The paid-analysis request form was submitted.
executive_events.decision_use: Commercial-intent event; source/asset/cluster travel with the form.

executive_events.name: paid_conversion
executive_events.meaning: Payment was confirmed by an authorized human process.
executive_events.decision_use: Revenue source of truth. Manual until a payment system is connected.

diagnostic_events.name: cta_click
diagnostic_events.meaning: A CTA was clicked; diagnostic only, not executive dashboard.

collector_status: Vendor-neutral browser instrumentation. Events push to dataLayer/gtag when a collector is installed; form attribution is captured immediately in submitted form fields.
